messages.subject: Meeting Thursday 10-noon
messages.body_plain:
Hi D-RUGgies!

This Thursday (1/9) will be the first D-RUG for the Winter Quarter (details below). This week during D-RUG we will have office hours and discuss plans for the quarter to come. Datalab will also be open for Tea Time and Co-working on Thursday afternoon.

D-RUG: 10am-noon, DataLab Classroom, Library 360, and zoom https://ucdavis.zoom.us/j/96397082218?pwd=S0JXcW5hcUFkbTcwMHFQV1NVNkg3Zz09
Tea Time: 1-2pm, DataLab Classroom, Library 360
Co-working: 2-4pm, DataLab Conference Room, Library 362

Please consider posting your questions to our Discourse <https://d-rug.discourse.group/> site in advance of attending D-RUG virtually. This helps us do a better job of answering your questions, and also keep a log of the types of questions we see frequently.

See you then,

Your D-RUG Coo[R]dinators

messages.body_plain:
Hi D-RUGgies!

We will be meeting this Thursday (1/16) from 10-noon virtually and in person in the DataLab classroom (Library 360). This is a group working session so come with your questions for our expeRts, or just bring your laptop and get in some distraction free R-coding time. Additionally, if there are topics you would like to see someone do a deeper dive on, let us know!

Datalab will also be open for Tea Time and Co-working on Thursday afternoon.

D-RUG: 10am-noon, DataLab Classroom, Library 360, and zoom https://ucdavis.zoom.us/j/96397082218?pwd=S0JXcW5hcUFkbTcwMHFQV1NVNkg3Zz09

messages.subject: We want to hear from you!
messages.subject_clean: We want to hear from you!
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

We want to get a sense from the D-RUG community about how to structure our sessions this year. Are there certain mini-workshops that would be super helpful to you? Do you want us to maximize time to answer your questions about R? Please take this (very short) survey <https://ucdavis.co1.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_7aGPto3cLGGjlHM> to share your thoughts!

Thanks so much,
Your D-RUG Coo[R]dinators
